Chief Financial Officer; principal financial officer and principal accounting officer
The conclusion of employment; not due to disagreements on operations, policies, or practices

65, CPA with 35+ years in finance/accounting across gaming, manufacturing, hospitality, healthcare; recent roles include independent consultant, COO of Center Point Bio-Tech (2023–2024), Regional Practice Leader at Eide Bailly (2021–2023); BS Accounting, San Jose State; 30+ years SEC reporting experience
